variants.name: 85 g
variants.about_this_item:
ROYAL CANIN® Urinary Care in Gravy is a nutritionally complete and balanced formula specially designed to help support a healthy urinary environment for optimal urinary tract health.

ROYAL CANIN® Urinary Care has proven results. Our study* showed that this diet supported a healthy urinary tract in participating healthy cats in just 10 days of being fed with the Urinary Care nutritional programme (combining both the dry kibble and wet food formulas).

ROYAL CANIN® Urinary Care is also available in jelly, or as a dry kibble diet. A mixture of both wet food and dry food provides the variety cats love. *Royal Canin internal study.

  • Proven Results Front: PROVEN RESULTS SUPPORTS A HEALTHY URINARY TRACT IN 10 DAYS*
variants.ingredient_information:
COMPOSITION: meat and animal derivatives, cereals, minerals, derivatives of vegetable origin, yeasts.

ADDITIVES (per kg): Nutritional additives: Vitamin D3: 250 IU, Iron (3b103): 2 mg, Iodine (3b202): 0.24 mg, Copper (3b405, 3b406): 1.9 mg, Manganese (3b502, 3b503, 3b504): 0.5 mg, Zinc (3b603, 3b605, 3b606): 5 mg.

ANALYTICAL CONSTITUENTS: Protein: 9.2%, Fat content: 3.0%, Crude ash: 1.6%, Crude fibres: 0.7%, Moisture: 81.7%.
